cs.t: Pacsafe.  https://pacsafe.com/collections/urban  Absolutely love these bags; paired with MasterLock. Mostly for travel. My Venturesafe 15L is my default laptop bag that I will use day-to-day and bring with me if I am traveling with anything other than the Vibe 28L. And sometimes bring it then too. (the 15L holds a 13" Mac + remarable tablet + wires/dongle/power-converters bag + one light change of clothes + few other things like passport, small snacks, meds/advil, water bottle etc) Earlier this year I stayed overnight (6 hours) landside in YYZ near the AC area with couches. They had heavy or bolted end tables next to the couch and it was the first time I really used the detachable & lockable strap feature to secure the bag from being swiped while I slept. Had the bags for years never had a need for it, but that just renewed my love for them. The Metrosafe is one I am looking to get next, just haven't found my self needing a new one yet with the others.
